column6: Holder of every SimpleNetworkWrapper message and handler pair (registered in deci.aD.n)
S2C: clear an inventory slot of another player on the client
S2C: set an inventory slot (and optionally held item) of another player, used to show held guns
S2C to trackers: public part of PlayerData (stance, gesture, parachute, armor slots, cape, clan, humanity)
Client handler, stores into the client player data cache
S2C to owner: full PlayerData snapshot
S2C: spawn a Decimation particle by name at a position
S2C: spawn a vanilla particle by name at a position
S2C: nuclear warhead explosion sound plus screen flash for a player (0 = all)
S2C: show a notification text to one player
S2C: server tick countdown value shown on the client
S2C: the rolled loot inventory contents, stored in client PlayerData before the loot GUI opens
C2S: key action (whistle, stance, firemode, gestures, attach/craft GUI, holster, vehicle lights, unharness dog)
S2C: spawns a Jet particle at the local player
C2S: player starts or stops climbing (gesture 4), ignored when disableClimbing
S2C: play a sound at a position or at the player
S2C: one chunk of an admin requested screenshot, reassembled and shown in a viewer GUI
S2C: asks the client to take a screenshot (hides GUI for 2 frames)
C2S: one chunk of the client screenshot sent to the server
Server handler, kicks on invalid data
S2C: zone boxes per type (safezone, military, radiation, scary, police) as "x/y/z=x/y/z" strings, stored in deci.b.i for client rendering
S2C: set the client weather type (deci.aI.a) for a player or everyone
S2C: set text of a deci.ac.h tile entity
C2S: creative player edits the text of a deci.ac.h tile entity
S2C: set two float values (rotation, scale) on a deci.ac.g tile entity
C2S: creative player rotates a TileEntityProp
S2C: set text field of a deci.S.f tile entity
C2S: creative player edits text of a deci.S.f tile entity
S2C: set decal name and size on a deci.S.e tile entity
C2S: creative player edits decal name and size on a deci.S.e tile entity
C2S: player typing indicator on or off
S2C: add a white bullet tracer line from start to end
C2S: apply poison to an entity by id (no validation, exploitable)
C2S: flashbang entity (deci.ak.o) detonated; server sends flash strength to every player looking at it
Server handler with line of sight check
C2S: set stance when not riding
C2S: set aim down sights mode (PlayerData VI)
S2C: camera shake from an explosion, scaled by distance
C2S: buy (id 0) or sell (id 1) an item at a trader NPC for caps (hW 0) or gold caps (hW 1), validated against the trader offer list
S2C: stop the stereo music playing at a block position
S2C: toggle stereo music track index at a position
C2S: player starts lockpicking the lock at a position (handler net.decimation.mod.common.handlers.d)
S2C: lockpick result (success, code, flags) (handler net.decimation.mod.common.handlers.c)
C2S: submit a code for the lock at a position (handler net.decimation.mod.common.handlers.b)
C2S: place a cap bounty (150 to 10000) on an online player
S2C: play the human hurt sound at an entity if close
C2S: reload step for the held gun (0 unload magazine and choose ammo type, 1 bolt and insert ammo, 2 store prevAmmo)
S2C: bullet bounce sound by surface type
S2C: another entity fired; play gun sound and spawn tracer lines (6 pellets for shotguns)
C2S: fire held crossbow or rocket launcher, server spawns bolt, rocket (HS, NWH variants) or grenade entity
C2S: client reports a hitscan hit (target id, damage, hit height, time); server applies leg break chance, armor damageMultiplier (not helmet) and gunDeci damage
Server handler (the only reader of ItemArmorDeci.damageMultiplier)
C2S: bullet hit a block; server broadcasts explode and blockcrack particles there
C2S: player fired the held gun; server consumes the shot and broadcasts PacketGunFireEffects
C2S: throw the held throwable (deci.aA.a) with a charge strength 0..10, refused near safezones on dedicated servers only
S2C: append a string to client list deci.b.i.bX
S2C: append a string to client list deci.b.j.cM (kill feed or notices)
S2C: flash a player (or all with 0) with given strength and play the flashed sound
S2C: play random.explode loudly at a position
Client handler; also hosts the static kick helper used by the anticheat
S2C: set the yaw of the vehicle another player drives
C2S: driver input (PlayerData Vp/Vq) and vehicle yaw, relayed to everyone
S2C: clear client list deci.b.i.bX for a player or everyone
S2C: play near or distant human death sound at an entity
C2S: reopen the loot GUI (GUI_LOOT) on the server
C2S: pick up an EntityItem with the pickup key (respects spectator and pickup timer)
S2C: copy a string to the player's system clipboard
S2C: clear the client clan info lists
S2C: clan members, allies and a third list for the clan GUI
C2S: player cape design, cape toggle and emblem id
S2C: asks the client to send its cosmetics (PacketSetCosmetics)
S2C: anticheat, asks the client to send its mod file hashes (sent on login unless allowAdditionalMods)
C2S: anticheat, client mod file hashes and names; server kicks on unknown hashes (BoehMod Anticheat)
S2C: bumps a client hit indicator alpha (deci.b.i.cs) by 0.25
S2C: four doubles stored in deci.b.j cS..cV (no sender found, likely unused)
S2C: four doubles stored in deci.b.j cO..cR (no sender found, likely unused)
S2C: two longs and a string stored in deci.b.j cW, cX, cY
S2C: contents of the player's backpack container, written into the client backpack item
S2C: backpack, vest and mask of a player for other clients
